description: Smoke-test subset for the SafeVerify->Comparator migration, REJECT path: 5 OEIS conjectures that NO model ever settled -- each was attempted and scored INCORRECT in all 15 historical result runs (every model, every budget), so they are extremely hard/open. Paired with a low $50/sample budget, a live agent submits attempts that Comparator rejects, exercising the reject path end to end. Not a benchmark subset.
